'''Boonta''', formerly known as '''Ko Vari''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that had been colonized by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] long ago. Despite it being a devastated world, Boonta was famous in the galaxy for its [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] and [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] races.

==Description==
The planet Boonta was a planet located in the vicinity of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="ThisIsPodracing">{{SW|url=news/this-is-podracing-sports-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-part-1|series=Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|text=Part 1: This Is Podracing|nolive=1}}</ref> It was the fourth of seven planets in the [[Dernatine system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Polyhedron" /> The Dernatine system was known as a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" /> Boonta was orbited by a scrapyard which served as a repair facility for damaged [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A plumbing supply plant was located on the farthest south of the three continents.<ref name="Polyhedron" />
[[File:Boonta.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Boonta as seen from space.]]

Boonta was known to be one of the three planets, with [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Arami]], where [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] races were organized to honor [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta the Hutt]].<ref name="ThisIsPodracing" /> According to the Hutts, Podraces were based on Ko Vari celebrations held by Boonta the Hutt each year after recapturing the planet during [[Xim Wars]], millennia ago. By that time, Tionese prisoners were chosen to run but all the losers would be executed.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Realizing that the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] dominant [[Human/Legends|Human]] species could not participate in the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] industry, [[Yenchara]] the Hutt of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] saw the opportunity for increased profits on [[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]] by establishing the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] on Ko Vari. Attracting Human colonists, the race led to the rise of other extreme sports such as the annual [[Zed'hoffa Orbital Diving Competition]] over the [[Living Pits]].<ref name="Polyhedron" /> The rise in profits from the races would continue to assist the planet's economy in the decades leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="whitewitch">''{{DroidsCite|The White Witch}}''</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
Formerly known as Ko Vari, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] established control during the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> It became was a highly settled world.<ref name="Polyhedron" /> Between [[25,120 BBY|25,120]] and [[25,096 BBY]], the planet was annexed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> Most of the population of the planet was decimated during the [[Sack of Ko Vari]].<ref name="Xim Week 4">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref> After the defeat of Xim at the [[First Battle of Vontor]], Ko Vari was eventually retook by [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv|Kossak]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> The planet was later renamed Boonta in honor of the hero Boonta the Hutt, who defeated Xim the Despot.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Even if Ko Vari was terribly ravaged by Xim the Despot during the war, some historians later suggested that a major cataclysm may have occurred well after the time of Xim, corroborating stories that the Hutts had used it as a testing site for centuries of extermination experiments.<ref name="Xim Week 2">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>

===Old republic era===
In [[11,920 BBY]], Boonta was victim of the [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Millennia later, near the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], the Hutts signed a non-aggression pact with the Sith. The Republic responded by a devastating [[Battle of Ko Vari (Boonta)|attack]] against the Hutt [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at Ko Vari. [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Republic Swift Fleet|Swift Fleet]] decimated much of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] fleet stationed there, leaving the planet depopulated one more time.<ref name="TEA" /> Ko Vari never entirely recovered from all the catastrophes that occurred during the campaigns of Xim the Despot and the Great Sith War.<ref name="Polyhedron" />

In [[3963 BBY]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], after successfully [[Battle of the Dennogra system|conquering]] [[Dennogra/Legends|Dennogra]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Battle of the Dernatine system (Mandalorian Wars)|invaded]] Boonta and had won the battle.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Boonta_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The stadium where the Boonta Speeder Race was held.]]

===Later history===
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="ThisIsPodracing" /> [[Jord Dusat]], [[Kea Moll]], and [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] of [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]] won the Boonta Speeder Race with ''[[White Witch]]'', despite opposition from the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], whom [[Sise Fromm]] had hired to kill the young racers.<ref name="racetothefinish" />

The world was later [[Battle of the Dernatine system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[44 ABY]], the world hosted a relay post for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]]. The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] relayed a message to Boonta from a public [[Simu-tunnel/Legends|S-thread]] booth on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]], revealing that she and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] had tracked [[Abeloth]] to the moon.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The term Boonta is mistakenly used to name the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] (p.350).
